description: So smol. So scared. Hopefully he'll relax after he's your pet for a while.

name: Frigid FrostWeaver Companion

description: The 1st Froggy of Chaos! Awww… how cute!

name: Frost Beetle
description: Happy Frostval! With this little guy by your side, you will never need ice cubes again!

name: Frost Draglin
description: This frost draglin was raised with care by the Mistress of the Moglins, Eonaleth but stolen by the dread dragon Frostfang. Now you've rescued it!

name: Frost Fangbeast Pet
description: These creatures once lived only on the distant ice planet of Glacera until brought here by Kezeroth and Karok.

name: Frost Goblin Pet
description: He might look creepy but he's got your back. You might want to keep an eye on him, though, because we're not quite sure what he wants to use it for.

name: Frost Moglin
description: Happy Frostval!

name: Frost Reaper Pet
description: These creatures once lived only on the distant ice planet of Glacera until brought here by Kezeroth and Karok.

name: Frost Tiger of the Void
description: No matter their size, a cat is a cat, even — or especially — in a Nation of Fiends. It lingers here with you on a whim.

name: Frost Vampire's Kitten (AC)
description: Stay cool and cozy as you seek out your next victim.

name: Frost Vampire's Kitten (Legend)
description: Stay cool and cozy as you seek out your next victim.

name: Frost Vampragon
description: Modeled after the many species of Vampragons which populate the lands of AdventureQuest, you can now cuddle a supercute, superCOOL one of your very own!

name: Frost Wolf Pet
description: A lone wolf the hibernates when the days are longer, but when the tables have turned, It is on the prowl in its hunt for a companion to share its collection of ice crystals with. Today, it has found you and now you'll never look at them the same way again.

name: Frostborn Wolf Cub
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. Each wields weaponry that can rip your throat out faster than you can scream.

name: Frostborne Dracolich Pet
description: A Dracolich with bones of jagged ice. You don't have to feed them, and you can use their ribcage a mobile drink cooler. Is this humane? Ask a more important question. Are you going to let their talents go to waste?

name: Frostbringer's Flames Blade Pet
description: This blad definitaly has the cool factor down.

name: Frostfang Paragon Bank (0 AC)
description: One would think that a Paragon riding Frostfang would lead to nothing but utter disaster but appearently these guys would like to help store your extra items! Just don't be surprised if anything turns up missing.

name: Frostfang Paragon Bank (AC)
description: One would think that a Paragon riding Frostfang would lead to nothing but utter disaster but appearently these guys would like to help store your extra items! Just don't be surprised if anything turns up missing.

name: Frostfang Rider Quibble Bank Pet
description: One would think that Quibble riding Frostfang would lead to nothing but utter disaster but apparently these guys would like to help store your extra items! This bank pet will only be available during the 2018 Frostval in July event!

name: Frostfur Moglinster
description: A moglin got lost in the snow, but managed to toughen up and tough it out. Cursed candy helped out this time.

name: Frostfur Yetikin
description: Every wanted an abominable snowman as a pet. You're in luck.

name: Frostling Horror (Pet)
description: He may be little, but he sure isn't cute! You may want to keep him well fed… or he may just start gnawing on you. (This pet has a quest attached.)

description: Maybe the inside is a portal to a larger loot room - who knows! Unlock ALL of the 2020 Frostval rare gear instantly as it releases. (Cannot be sold.)

description: She has a spell that makes it easier to slide down a chimney with a big bag of gifts. Arcana still thinks its breaking and entering someone's property, but Juvania and the children are always so delighted. She has to wear the hat for them.

name: Frostval Box Elf
description: What a funny little Elf! Are they here to help wrap the gifts - Hey, wait! Why did you dump all the toys! Where are you taking those boxes?

name: Frostval Chaos Twin Companions
description: So, we told Drakath that we usually use magic to change our clothes. "Then why did you spend so much on Frostval shopping?" Cause it's fun, duh. (Click to activate Customizer UI)

name: Frostval Collection Chest 2017
description: This icy treasure chest holds more than it looks like it could… over 30 Frostval event items, plus 2 exclusive pets, and a character page badge! Maybe the inside is a portal to a larger loot room - who knows!

name: Frostval Constantine Companion
description: Constantine would have worn the full red Frostval suit, but he would have passed out from the heat. (Click to activate Armor Customizer UI)

name: Frostval Cysero Companion
description: The Mad Weaponsmith's holly jolly cheer outfit! You better watch out! you better watch out! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT, YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! YOU BETTER WATCH OUT! Cysero Clause is coming. He's coming.

name: Frostval Darkovia Rulers
description: Just for Frostval, the Vampires and Werewolves shelve their rivalry. Just make sure you stand between them. Do not let them make eye contact. (Click to activate Customizer UI)

name: Frostval Drago Companion
description: Come here. Tell holly, jolly papa Drago what you want for Frostval. As if. This is the evilest version of a mall Santa that you can imagine.

name: Frostval Elegy Trio Companion
description: Had the Elegy ended differently, your Frostvals would be a lot wilder.

name: Frostval Elf Twig
description: *No description*

name: Frostval Emperor Linus
description: A festive little buddy, but they aren't that fun at parties. It might be because of the 'Emperor's' elitism.

name: Frostval Fa Bank Buddy
description: Winter is prime game time. If I have to spend another second wasting my holiday break on whatever you're doing, I'm going to pour lemon juice in your eggnog.

description: MINIONS! YOUR LORD AND MASTER, NULGATH THE ARCHFIEND, WILL NOW DO THE BATTLE BY YOUR SIDE! DO NOT DISAPPOINT HIM!

name: Frostval Giftbox Mort Moglin Pet

description: This purple fella rushed all the way over from the coast to join the snowy festivities. They smell like flowers, and scented plushies are all the rage lately.

name: Frostval Giftbox Snowy Moglin Pet
description: Brighter, softer, and gentler than falling snow!

name: Frostval Giftbox Twig Pet
description: Just when you think you got one Twig, another bursts out of the present box! Double the fwish!

description: It's holly red, soft as a plushie, and can barely wait for you to open your present. Oh, what could it be?

description: This Giftkeeper will protect Frostval cheer with their life! Yes, holiday wonder is what they're defending. It isn't just about the boxes. Sure, the boxes are the most important part, but this is about Frostval!

description: Specifically, this Hashtog is #Frostval.

description: An eager best friend that wants to celebrate every day with you, not just Frostval!

description: The Rumbling of Cold Thunder if it leaned more into the cold than the thunder. It makes Iona resemble the Ice Elves her ancestors adored and despised.

description: Gravelyn the Good cherishes the memories of her father celebrating the holidays with her, and reminiscing over the piles of coal her mother accumulated over the years.

description: One's holly, one's jolly, and one's naughty!

name: Frostval Moglinster
description: Merry Frostvale and Happy New Year!

description: Now you can have your very own wise man that can give you sage advice and speak mind-soothing riddles… and for Frostval, he'll carry all your gifts, too!

description: Deep in the frozen Northlands, high-pitched giggles ring out,and all shudder, knowing that the Chaos Twins are near… and trouble isn't far behind.
